review_type: Repository-owner-commissioned AI-assisted Econometrica numerical-methods advisory review
recommendation: Reject in the present form and do not continue this cumulative manuscript through another ordinary revision round. A new, sharply focused paper on from-primitives neural policy construction and direct all-state certification in compact nonlinear control could merit evaluation, but R44 does not establish an Econometrica-level method-specific contribution for the broad Neural Bellman Operators program.
blocking_findings: The positive certificate, retained-policy, and paired-score results are method neutral and do not isolate the incremental numerical value of NBO.
Postselected verification-only recertification does not improve the original capped training-to-certificate service's reliability.
The finer verification is computationally large and is not compared with conventional methods on a common prospective certificate frontier.
All twenty-four direct neural-minus-ridge policy-cost intervals contain zero, with no predeclared economic superiority or equivalence margin.
Spline and ridge remain at least as compelling on accuracy, reliability, signed policy cost, or target-crossing work in every completed experiment.
There is no stable matched end-to-end work-to-certified-accuracy comparison under a common repeated timing protocol.
The nonlinear evidence remains one- and two-dimensional and tensor-cover dependent; no nonlinear scaling frontier or adaptive sparse conventional comparator is executed.
Nonlinear optimizer reliability is undefined beyond three fixed seed labels and a finite deterministic catalogue.
Adaptive precision remains an adverse work result rather than an empirical numerical advantage.
The stylized economic result and linked broad platform scope are disproportionate to the method-specific evidence established by R44.
positive_findings: R44 is a coherent, immutable, source-bound review-ready manuscript rather than a detached workflow artifact.
The centered policy certificate and retained-policy corollary appear internally coherent under their stated assumptions.
The paired telescoping score supplies the correct direct fixed-policy cost estimand under conditional expectation.
The seven recertifications retain network and actor identities and do not rewrite the original capped-service failures.
All twenty-four unresolved direct intervals and every adverse conventional comparison are reported without relabeling them as successes.
The repository's provenance, preservation, record hashing, tests, and compilation audits are exceptionally strong.

limitations: The reviewer did not rerun the full nonlinear training catalogue or all twenty-four paired simulations; new executions would create new optimization and timing observations.
The reviewer verified all frozen record and source identities, reexecuted the repository tests, reconstructed the reported aggregate arithmetic, and reran one scalar recertification byte-identically.
The exact mathematical spot checks do not constitute an independent proof of every inherited theorem or application.
Single-run and cross-host clocks support no hardware-general performance inference.
No claim is made that spline or ridge dominates outside the declared R44 scalar and coupled economies.
This advisory review is not an Econometric Society editorial decision.
